title: Isaac named before birth beside Jesus named before birth (Gen 17:19, Matt 1:20-21)
summary: Pairs God's instruction to name Abraham's son Isaac (Genesis 17:19, headed 18:19) with the angel's instruction to Joseph to name Mary's Son yeshua because He will save His people from their sins (Matthew 1:20-21). Matching colours link the sons, the mothers and the Holy Spirit.
